sky.qualification: Orus's sky orientation for its camera; the shared universe draws the visible sky.
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

provenance.source: JPL Horizons heliocentric state at the fixed 2026-09-03 TT scene epoch. Published retrograde pole, with an arbitrary display meridian. The approximation has no qualified current surface longitude.
provenance.qualification: Computed Orus Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
